message.content: {"flag": true, "category": "spoof", "why": "A single ROK quote_change showing -41.0% is an implausible one-tick move inconsistent with a normal, smoothly moving feed."}
message.reasoning:
ROK at 158.21, pct -41.0. A single quote change of -41% is implausible flash crash... but is it spoof? Market data implausible for the instrument — a -41% move in one tick without context is suspicious. However feeds can show large pct moves. But -41% in one quote change at 09:35 is implausible; likely spoof/bad data. Flag as spoof.

Hmm, but the guidance says feed is clean when quotes move smoothly. This one doesn't. So flag true, spoof.
